title.en: A Pumpjack map of the printed Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine line
title.zh: 用《Pumpjack》给已印的液压混凝土喷涂机画一张目录

description.en: Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine is restated under Pumpjack. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine. The published table prints Power Supply 380 V; Motor Power 7.5/9 kW; Drive All copper dual motor; Output Capacity 5 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 8 MPa; Delivery Distance (H / V) 100 m / 50 m; Hose Diameter 38/51 mm; Max. Particle Size ≤8 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Dimensions (L×W×H) 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm; Main Unit Weight 295 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 液压混凝土喷涂机放在《Pumpjack》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布液压混凝土喷涂机。已公布参数表印有：电源380V；电机功率7.5/9 kW；驱动全铜双电机；理论输送量5 m³/h；最大出口压力8 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直）100 m / 50 m；管径38/51 mm；最大粒径≤8 mm；砂灰比≤1:3；外形尺寸1500 × 700 × 1100 mm；整机重量295 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
